_about: Plausible upper bounds for behaviour rates in Vietnamese urban traffic, used by the Phase 3 realism filter. These are placeholder priors from field observation; replace them with statistics measured from real trajectories: python calib/fit_from_tracks.py tracks.csv --out calib/measured.json

wrongWayShare.what: share of two-wheeler riding time spent against traffic

cutInsPerVehMin.what: lateral moves into a gap under 3 m in front of a car, per vehicle-minute

suddenBrakesPerTwoMin.what: decelerations above 3.5 m/s^2 without an obvious reason, per two-wheeler-minute

npcCollisionsPerMin.what: contacts between background road users per minute (should be rare)

instantStopsPerVehMin.what: stops from above 3 m/s within one step (physically implausible), per vehicle-minute

hitRate.what: episodes in which someone else drives into the self-driving car (guards against 'suicidal' scenarios)
